name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Runic Armasaur's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: whenever Runic Armasaur's triggered ability would trigger
other: Runic Armasaur's oracle text: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a creature or land that isn't a mana ability, you may draw a card.

Requires Runic Armasaur to have power 2 or less at the time of the trigger (Delney's ability text: "Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater. If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.") - both cards confirm this at their printed base power, but power can change from effects elsewhere in the deck (e.g. -1/-1 counters, boosts); not checked against every other card's interaction with this power threshold.

Relevant to Phase 32 robustness testing against activated-ability-heavy metagames (the assignment explicitly lists this as a robustness dimension) - Delney meaningfully increases the deck's punish for that specific field composition.

result.summary: Runic Armasaur's opponent-activated-ability draw trigger fires twice per qualifying opponent activation, drawing 2 cards instead of 1.

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
